text_block_list.text:
I was walking with Oguri Cap during lunch 
break, but she seemed somewhat down.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry... Lately, no matter how much I 
sleep or eat, I just can't muster any 
strength...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Would it be better if I just ate more, I 
wonder... *sigh*

"It's likely due to running in consecutive 
races. We should review the schedule for 
the future."
